parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output file format. Allowed values: xlsx (default), csv. Background exports auto-fall back to csv above 15,000 rows.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which records to export. Allowed values: filtered (apply current filter/sort — default), all (ignore filters), current_page (force sync streaming export of current page), selected (use the comma-separated ids param).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated SalesOrderLineFinancial IDs. Required when scope=selected.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Mirrors the index endpoint filters — any filter[*] param accepted by the list endpoint is honoured here.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Mirrors the index endpoint sort param.
